slider.question: On a scale of 1 to 10 — how connected do you feel to your partner right now?
slider.subtext: no right answer · only your truth

honestMoment.dividerText: This number isn't a verdict. It's a starting point.

segments.segment_1: Most people wouldn't admit this. You just did. That takes courage — and it's exactly why you're here. Let's start by being honest.
segments.segment_2: Most people open this app at a 5. You opened it at {score}. That's honest. Let's work with that.
segments.segment_3: Most people open this app at a 5. You opened it at {score}. You're doing better than you think — and we'll make sure it stays that way.
segments.segment_4: {score} out of 10. You're here because you want to protect something good. That's the smartest thing a couple can do. Let's keep it that way.
segments.segment_5: 10. Either things are genuinely perfect — or you're being very kind to yourself. Either way, we'll find out. Let's begin.

set_a.prompt: When you think about your relationship right now, the feeling that sits heaviest is ___
set_a.optionA: A loneliness that's strange because they're right there
set_a.optionB: A tiredness — like you've been trying for a long time

set_a.prompt: The last time you felt genuinely close to your partner was ___
set_a.optionA: Longer ago than you're comfortable admitting
set_a.optionB: Hard to remember clearly — which tells you everything

set_a.prompt: If you had to name the one thing that slowly changed between you two, it would be ___
set_a.optionA: You stopped really talking — conversations became logistics
set_a.optionB: You stopped choosing each other — it became automatic, not intentional

set_a.prompt: When you reflect on where things are, you feel ___
set_a.optionA: Like you've tried — and you're not sure it's been enough
set_a.optionB: Like there are things you could have done differently that you haven't yet

set_a.prompt: The thing you're most afraid of right now is ___
set_a.optionA: That this becomes permanent — that this is just who you are now
set_a.optionB: That one of you will stop trying before the other is ready

set_a.prompt: Even now, somewhere in you, you believe ___
set_a.optionA: This relationship has something worth fighting for
set_a.optionB: You're not sure yet — but you're here, which means something

set_a.prompt: You opened this app today because ___
set_a.optionA: You're not ready to give up — you just need somewhere to start
set_a.optionB: You want to understand what happened before you decide anything

set_b.prompt: The space between you and your partner right now feels ___
set_b.optionA: Like something drifted — slowly, quietly, without a single big moment
set_b.optionB: Like something broke — and neither of you has fully acknowledged it yet

set_b.prompt: When something hurts, you ___
set_b.optionA: Keep it inside — because saying it out loud feels like opening something you can't close
set_b.optionB: Say something — but it rarely comes out the way you meant it to

set_b.prompt: Right now, the effort in your relationship feels ___
set_b.optionA: One-sided — and you're not sure which side you're even on anymore
set_b.optionB: Absent — like you've both gone quiet at the same time

set_b.prompt: The last time you felt truly seen by your partner was ___
set_b.optionA: A while ago — it happened, just not recently
set_b.optionB: You're struggling to think of a specific moment right now

set_b.prompt: The one thing that could actually move something right now is ___
set_b.optionA: One real conversation — not a fight, just an honest one
set_b.optionB: One moment of feeling chosen — not out of habit, but on purpose

set_b.prompt: The question you ask yourself most about this relationship is ___
set_b.optionA: Is this just a hard season — or have we become strangers?
set_b.optionB: Do they still see me — or just the version of me they got used to?

set_b.prompt: You're here because ___
set_b.optionA: Love is still there — it's just buried under everything else
set_b.optionB: You want to find out if love is enough to rebuild on

set_a.prompt: When you're honest about your relationship right now, it mostly feels ___
set_a.optionA: Fine on the surface — but not quite what it used to be underneath
set_a.optionB: Like you're both waiting for something to shift, without saying it

set_a.prompt: The place you feel least connected to your partner is ___
set_a.optionA: In the everyday — the routines have replaced the real conversations
set_a.optionB: In the emotional — you talk, but you're not sure they really hear you

set_a.prompt: There is something between you right now that neither of you has said out loud. That thing is closer to ___
set_a.optionA: A low-level frustration that keeps recycling
set_a.optionB: Something you genuinely need that you haven't found the words for yet

set_a.prompt: When there's tension between you, your instinct is to ___
set_a.optionA: Address it — even imperfectly, even messily
set_a.optionB: Let it settle first — you need to process before you can speak

set_a.prompt: Your relationship right now compared to a year ago is ___
set_a.optionA: Comfortable — which is good, but also a little too quiet
set_a.optionB: Different in a way you haven't fully named yet

set_a.prompt: The thing most coming between you and your partner right now is ___
set_a.optionA: Life — the pace, the stress, the endless list of things that aren't each other
set_a.optionB: Something between the two of you specifically — not external, internal

set_a.prompt: What you actually want from this relationship right now is ___
set_a.optionA: To feel close again — not perfect, just genuinely close
set_a.optionB: To feel like you're both choosing this — not just maintaining it

set_b.prompt: Your relationship right now feels most like ___
set_b.optionA: A song you both know but have stopped actually listening to
set_b.optionB: A conversation that keeps getting interrupted before it gets real

set_b.prompt: When you think about who tries harder to keep things connected ___
set_b.optionA: You feel like you're carrying slightly more than your share
set_b.optionB: You feel like you're both trying — just in different directions

set_b.prompt: The last time you had a conversation that actually meant something was ___
set_b.optionA: Recently enough — but not as often as you'd like
set_b.optionB: Long enough ago that you feel it as a gap

set_b.prompt: The small thing that bothers you most — the one you never say — is ___
set_b.optionA: Feeling like you're not a priority when other things come up
set_b.optionB: Feeling like you have to manage your emotions before they feel safe to share

set_b.prompt: Even at a 4 or 5, the thing that's still clearly there is ___
set_b.optionA: Care — you genuinely care about each other, even when it's hard
set_b.optionB: History — you've built something real, even if it needs attention right now

set_b.prompt: If you traced back to when things started feeling less connected, it was probably ___
set_b.optionA: Gradual — no single moment, just a slow background drift
set_b.optionB: A specific period — something happened and the recovery was incomplete

set_b.prompt: The version of your relationship you still believe is possible looks like ___
set_b.optionA: Coming home to each other — not just to the same house
set_b.optionB: Talking the way you used to — before the filters went up

set_a.prompt: The clearest sign your relationship is in a good place right now is ___
set_a.optionA: The ease — things feel natural, comfortable, genuinely safe
set_a.optionB: The growth — you're both different people than when you started, in the best way

set_a.prompt: Your partner knows you love them most because of ___
set_a.optionA: The consistent small things you do without needing to be asked
set_a.optionB: The way you show up fully when something actually matters

set_a.prompt: Even in a good relationship, the one thing you'd quietly change is ___
set_a.optionA: The depth of your conversations — more real, less routine
set_a.optionB: The frequency of intentional time — more chosen moments, fewer accidental ones

set_a.prompt: When something small creates friction between you ___
set_a.optionA: You address it quickly — you've learned not to let things accumulate
set_a.optionB: You give it space — you've learned that not everything needs a conversation

set_a.prompt: The thing about your relationship that's only yours — that outsiders wouldn't understand — is ___
set_a.optionA: A private language — references, looks, words that belong only to the two of you
set_a.optionB: A way of being together that just works — hard to explain, obvious when you're in it

set_a.prompt: The thing you're most intentional about protecting in your relationship is ___
set_a.optionA: The quality time — not letting life quietly eat it all
set_a.optionB: The honesty — not letting comfort become performance

set_a.prompt: You and your partner are ___
set_a.optionA: Building something — there's a clear sense of direction and shared purpose
set_a.optionB: Enjoying something — the present is genuinely good and that's enough right now

set_b.prompt: At the core, your relationship works because ___
set_b.optionA: You're genuinely compatible — you want the same things in the same direction
set_b.optionB: You've worked at it — it's good because you've both chosen to make it good

set_b.prompt: You and your partner are most connected when ___
set_b.optionA: You're in motion together — doing something, going somewhere, in an experience
set_b.optionB: You're completely still — just present, no agenda, nowhere to be

set_b.prompt: If you were to identify the one area that could quietly make your relationship even better ___
set_b.optionA: It would be saying more of what you actually feel — not less
set_b.optionB: It would be doing more of what matters — not just what's convenient

set_b.prompt: Your partner shows love mostly by ___
set_b.optionA: Paying attention — remembering things, noticing things, being present
set_b.optionB: Acting — doing things, solving things, showing up in practical ways

set_b.prompt: The relationship you want to have is ___
set_b.optionA: One that keeps surprising you — that stays curious and alive
set_b.optionB: One that becomes unshakeable — deep roots, total trust, total ease

set_b.prompt: The thing you do best together — that you're quietly proud of — is ___
set_b.optionA: How you handle difficulty — you come out of hard things closer
set_b.optionB: How you enjoy each other — the lightness is real and it's rare

set_b.prompt: You're using this app because ___
set_b.optionA: Something this good deserves to be actively looked after
set_b.optionB: You know that good relationships don't stay good without intention

set_a.prompt: Your relationship at 8 or 9 feels like ___
set_a.optionA: Something you grew — it took time and work and it shows
set_a.optionB: Something you found — a rare fit that you both recognised and held onto

set_a.prompt: The thing that makes your relationship feel like home is ___
set_a.optionA: Being completely yourself — no performance, no editing, just you
set_a.optionB: Being completely safe — knowing they're there regardless of what comes

set_a.prompt: Even at an 8 or 9, the one thing you don't always say out loud is ___
set_a.optionA: How much you need to hear that you're valued — not assumed, actually said
set_a.optionB: How much you notice the small things they do — and how much it means

set_a.prompt: When you and your partner disagree, the thing you do best is ___
set_a.optionA: Come back to each other — the repair is always faster than the rupture
set_a.optionB: Stay fair — neither of you fights dirty, even when it's hard

set_a.prompt: The thing about your partner that you genuinely admire — that goes beyond love — is ___
set_a.optionA: The way they move through difficulty — their resilience quietly amazes you
set_a.optionB: The way they see the world — their perspective consistently surprises you

set_a.prompt: The question you come back to privately is ___
set_a.optionA: Are we growing in the same direction — or has the direction quietly shifted?
set_a.optionB: Am I being the partner they actually need — not just the one I think I'm being?

set_a.prompt: At 8 or 9, what you're most committed to protecting is ___
set_a.optionA: The depth — the knowing-each-other that took years to build
set_a.optionB: The spark — making sure comfort never becomes invisible to each other

set_b.prompt: Your relationship right now feels most like ___
set_b.optionA: A well-worn favourite thing — comfortable, trusted, completely yours
set_b.optionB: Something still being discovered — familiar but not yet fully known

set_b.prompt: How you stay close ___
set_b.optionA: The way you communicate — honestly, often, even about the hard things
set_b.optionB: The way you prioritise each other — not by accident, by choice

set_b.prompt: If there's one small thing slightly missing right now at an 8 or 9, it's ___
set_b.optionA: More spontaneity — things are good but slightly predictable
set_b.optionB: More depth in conversation — things are warm but sometimes surface-level

set_b.prompt: You feel most loved by your partner when ___
set_b.optionA: They stop everything and are just completely there with you
set_b.optionB: They do something that proves they were thinking about you when you weren't around

set_b.prompt: The thing you two do better together than separately is ___
set_b.optionA: Handle hard things — you're each other's best thinking partner
set_b.optionB: Enjoy ordinary things — the mundane is genuinely good when they're in it

set_b.prompt: To move from an 8 to a 10, the thing that would make the most difference is ___
set_b.optionA: More honesty about the things you hold back even in a safe relationship
set_b.optionB: More presence — being together without the background noise of everything else

set_b.prompt: The truest sentence about your relationship right now is ___
set_b.optionA: We've built something real — and I don't take that lightly
set_b.optionB: We're still building — and that's the part I love most

set_a.prompt: Your 10 is ___
set_a.optionA: Earned — you've done the work and this is what it feels like
set_a.optionB: Genuine — it's just always been this way and you're aware of how rare that is

set_a.prompt: When you say 10, you mean ___
set_a.optionA: Complete trust — you could say anything and know it would be held safely
set_a.optionB: Complete ease — being with them is the most natural thing in your life

set_a.prompt: At a 10, the thing you still want more of is ___
set_a.optionA: Time — even at 10 the one currency you're always short of is uninterrupted time together
set_a.optionB: Expression — at 10 you sometimes assume they know things you haven't actually said

set_a.prompt: Your relationship is a 10 mostly because ___
set_a.optionA: You've navigated hard things together — the score reflects survival and growth
set_a.optionB: You simply work — the compatibility was always there and you both knew it

set_a.prompt: Your relationship feels most alive when ___
set_a.optionA: You're in something new together — travel, decisions, adventures, firsts
set_a.optionB: You're in something completely ordinary — and it's still the best place to be

set_a.prompt: The thing you've learned about being at a 10 is ___
set_a.optionA: You can't assume it — you have to keep choosing it
set_a.optionB: It doesn't mean perfect — it means you'd choose this exact person in any version of your life

set_a.prompt: You're using this app at a 10 because ___
set_a.optionA: The best thing you can do with something this good is pay attention to it
set_a.optionB: You want to know if your partner would give you the same number

set_b.prompt: A 10 for you means ___
set_b.optionA: Feeling genuinely chosen — not just stayed with, but actively chosen every day
set_b.optionB: Feeling genuinely known — the real version of you, not the curated one

set_b.prompt: The thing that pushes you from a 9 to a 10 is ___
set_b.optionA: Safety — you can be completely honest without calculating the risk first
set_b.optionB: Joy — there is a consistent lightness between you that you've never taken for granted

set_b.prompt: At a 10, the thing you notice most about your partner right now is ___
set_b.optionA: How much you still like them — separate from loving them, you genuinely like who they are
set_b.optionB: How much they've grown — you're with a different person than you started with, and they're better

set_b.prompt: Even at a 10, the question you occasionally ask yourself is ___
set_b.optionA: Am I growing as a partner at the same pace as this relationship deserves?
set_b.optionB: Are we saying the important things out loud — or just feeling them privately?

set_b.prompt: A 10 shows up in your daily life mostly as ___
set_b.optionA: A feeling — an underlying warmth that doesn't need a reason
set_b.optionB: A behaviour — the things you do automatically because this person matters

set_b.prompt: Your relationship is a 10 partly because you ___
set_b.optionA: Show up consistently — the reliability is real and it builds something solid
set_b.optionB: Stay curious — you haven't stopped wanting to know more about them

set_b.prompt: The reason a 10 needs this app is ___
set_b.optionA: Because attention is how a 10 stays a 10 — not by accident
set_b.optionB: Because you want to find out what your partner's number is — and what it means if it's different

steady_flame.name: The Steady Flame
steady_flame.subLabel: Consistent · Deeply felt · The long game
steady_flame.description: You don't do grand gestures — you do quiet, consistent love. You're the partner who remembers what they said three months ago. Your relationship feels like a warm room, not a fireworks show.
steady_flame.growth: You assume they know. They might not. Say it out loud more.

electric_spark.name: The Electric Spark
electric_spark.description: You are the reason your relationship feels alive. You're the one who books the trip, tries the new thing, falls in love with your partner repeatedly. Your relationship has never been boring because you won't let it be.
electric_spark.growth: The spark needs to land somewhere safe. Make sure they feel secure, not just excited.

deep_current.name: The Deep Current
deep_current.description: You think before you speak and feel before you act. Your love is not loud, but it is deep — the kind that runs underneath everything else and keeps it all moving. People think you're reserved; your partner knows the truth.
deep_current.growth: Your depth can feel like distance. Let them in before you've figured it all out.

shifting_tide.name: The Shifting Tide
shifting_tide.description: You are the partner who says what nobody else will say — and somehow makes it land without cruelty. You've probably had one really honest conversation that changed everything. You're not afraid of the hard stuff because you know it leads somewhere real.
shifting_tide.growth: Honesty without tenderness is just criticism. The how matters as much as the what.
